name: web-changelog-page-with-dotted-cyan-halftone-header-and-release-card
title: Dark changelog with a cyan halftone-dot banner, a dated release title, a placeholder feature card and contributor avatars with action icons
whatItIs: A black page whose top banner is a cyan and black dithered dot pattern with 'Changelog' and 'Latest Enhancements & Platform News', below a narrow column with a date, a release title 'v3.0.0: Major UI Refresh & New Integrations', a large dark card reading 'UI Refresh & Integrations', a short description, avatar chips '+1 contributors' and three icon buttons with a 'Show full release' tooltip.
whatItMeans: Technical and tidy; a dot banner brings texture to an otherwise text-driven page.
techniques: Use a dithered dot banner as a header.
Add small action icons with tooltips.

vocabulary.definition: A header made of dithered dots.
A dated block describing a version.
A small label describing an icon button.
